Davis Cup roundup: Czech Republic ousts US in second round The host Czech Republic rallied from a 2-1 deficit and captured both reverse singles matches over the United States to win 3-2 in Round 2 of Davis Cup qualifying play on Saturday in Prague.The Czech Republic will advance to the quarterfinals, while the United States has been eliminated.Davis ​Cup series are being contested worldwide this weekend to determine the seven teams that will join defending champion Italy in ‌the final stage at Bologna, Italy, from Nov. 24-29.The United States took a 2-1 lead when the doubles duo of Christian Harrison and Austin Krajicek pulled out a third-set tiebreaker to defeat Adam Pavlasek and Patrik Rikl 5-7, 6-3, 7-6 (8).U.S. Open finalist Ben Shelton, who dropped his Friday singles match to Jiri Lehecka, captured the first set over ​Jakub Mensik. But the world No. 15 rallied to defeat Shelton 5-7, 6-4, 6-3 to knot the match at 2-2.American Learner Tien, ​who got his side off to a 1-0 lead on Friday, took on Lehecka in the deciding match.
